changelog: Generate one short loopable instrumental from a scene description and duration after the user asks.

en.description: Describe the footage and get an original instrumental track written for it, yours to keep and use commercially. This AI background music generator turns a scene, mood, and tempo feel into royalty-free BGM for short videos, vlogs, product clips, tutorials, livestream and store loops, podcast intros, and slideshow recaps, with an energy arc you choose — a calm or immediate opening, a lift at the moment that matters, a clean ending — room left for narration, and a result you can listen to before you publish.
en.summary: Describe the footage and get an original instrumental track written for it, yours to keep and use commercially.
en.title: Short Video BGM Studio: AI Background Music for Video
